title: Search cabinets systematically before checking other furniture
description: Use this when looking for an object that is not immediately visible on countertops or tables.
content: When searching for a mug or similar item, check all cabinets in order, opening closed cabinets to inspect their contents, before moving on to other locations like the fridge or countertops.

description: Use this when a task requires cooling an object such as a mug.

title: Search adjacent containers systematically
description: When looking for an object in a multi-container environment
